scripts.test: esbuild srcts/__tests__/graphReplay.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --log-level=warning --outfile=node_modules/.cache/reactlog-test/graphReplay.test.cjs && node node_modules/.cache/reactlog-test/graphReplay.test.cjs && esbuild viewer/replay.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --outfile=node_modules/.cache/reactlog-test/report.cjs && node node_modules/.cache/reactlog-test/report.cjs
scripts.build: npm run lint-all && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build-only && npm run build-report
scripts.watch: npm run lint-all && npm run build-only -- --watch

linters.pkg-r/R/*.R: Rscript -e "devtools::load_all('pkg-r'); devtools::lint('pkg-r', cache = FALSE) -> lints; if(length(lints) > 0) print(lints); testthat::expect_equal(length(lints), 0)"
